docs: AniUI is React Native. On an existing RNR/NativeWind project, add and use directly — the tokens and aliases already match, no setup needed. On a fresh project, run `npx @aniui/cli init` first to configure NativeWind/Uniwind, theme tokens, and Metro/Babel. Blocks are full screens — move into your app/ route as needed.
